content: Stalling specifically at stop lights or when coming to a stop is a common rough idle issue. Causes include vacuum leaks, dirty throttle body, failing IAC valve, or EGR valve sticking open. Inspect idle control system and vacuum leaks.

Crank-no-fire means the engine cranks but does not start. Causes include no fuel, no spark, or out-of-time camshaft/crankshaft sensor. Check for spark at the plug, fuel pressure, and camshaft/crankshaft sensor signals.
